t: I've been turning it over all day and I'm no further on
I wouldn't say it if I hadn't been there
you can think what you like. I know what I saw
I keep expecting somebody to tell me I imagined it
I'm not asking you to believe me. I just needed to say it out loud
that's the whole of it. I've told you as straight as I can
and that's the god's hand, whatever anybody says
I've stopped looking for another explanation
you can feel it, can't you? something is here
I don't know what to make of it and I've had a day to try
half of me believes it and half of me doesn't. that's honest
I'm telling you what happened, not what it means
there'll be a reason for it. there always is
I'd rather be wrong about this than right
I can still see the shape of it when I shut my eyes
nobody should have to watch that twice
I'm not walking that road alone again. neither should you
we need somebody on the treeline. I'll do it myself if I have to
we ate. that's the part I keep coming back to
whoever left it, I'd like to thank them
I keep thinking about what I could have done sooner
we should do it properly. they were one of ours
I had to sit down after. my legs went
the whole village felt it, so at least I'm not mad
everybody's alright. that's not nothing, these days
the village needed a bit of good news
I've never seen the bushes come in like that
we should get out there before the birds do
I looked twice. there wasn't a mark left on it
I don't have an explanation and I've tried
roots and all, straight out of the ground
it's still lying there if you want to see for yourself
feet off the ground, clear air underneath. I saw it
I don't know how you explain that away
they went further than a person goes. that's all I'll say
I've been trying to work out the distance and it doesn't help
not a scratch on them. that's the part that gets me
gentle, is what it was. that's a strange thing to say about it
the ground took it harder than any fall I've seen
I felt it come up through my boots
well. I'll be thinking about that
thanks for telling me. I mean it
I don't know what to say to that
let me sit with it a while
I'd better get back to it. but thank you
we'll talk again. I want to hear it once more
right. I'm going to go and do something ordinary now
then we should be grateful, and say so
I'll say something at the shrine tonight
I want to believe you. give me a day
maybe. I'll keep my eyes open
I'm not saying you're lying. I'm saying I wasn't there
people see things. it doesn't make them wrong or right
if that costs us the stores, I need to know now
I'll walk the edge tonight either way
send them to me if they're hurt. don't let them tough it out
that's worth writing down properly
I'll keep an eye out on the road
well, the roof won't build itself either way
